failure_reason: 4 deterministic predicates failed against canonical artifact docs/tier4_orchestration_state/phase_outputs/phase7_budget_gate/budget_gate_assessment.json (schema_id: orch.phase7.budget_gate_assessment.v1, run_id: msca-pf-syn-01). Root cause: budget_gate_assessment.json was generated using lump-sum instrument logic for an MSCA-PF unit-cost instrument (confirmed by selected_call.json budget_regime: 'unit_cost' and unit_cost_budget.json instrument_type: 'MSCA-PF'). Per CLAUDE.md §8.1/§8.4 (C1 amendment), for unit-cost instruments the gate_09 budget source is the internal deterministic derivation. unit_cost_budget.json shows gate_pass_declaration: 'pass', all four line items Confirmed, confirmed_months and host_country operator-declared Assumed, unresolved_components: [], blocking_inconsistencies: []. Resolution requires regenerating budget_gate_assessment.json using instrument-conditional logic that evaluates the unit_cost_budget.json derivation instead of the lump-sum received/ channel.
